tagline: A vertically integrated cannabis company operating retail and cultivation assets in Nevada
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue is the primary indicator of C21 Investments' operational performance and growth, reflecting successful expansion of its retail footprint in Nevada with the opening of a third store and scale economies from its cultivation operations.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company including retail sales from stores and wholesale revenue from cultivation operations.
kpis.description: Total revenue for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 amounted to $30.1 million, up 6.5% from $28.3 million in the prior year, primarily due to the opening of a third store in June 2024.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth driven by retail store portfolio expansion.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting direct costs of sales, reflecting production efficiency and pricing strategy.
kpis.description: Gross margin for fiscal year 2025 was 41.7%, up from 39.4% in the prior year, primarily driven by scale economies resulting from cultivation facility expansion and the opening of the third store.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement from cultivation expansion scale economies.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating earnings before depreciation, amortization, taxes, interest and non-recurring items, adjusted for share-based compensation and other non-cash items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal year 2025 was $4.87 million, up 7.4% from $4.53 million in the prior year, reflecting improved operating profitability.
kpis.signal: Adjusted operating profitability improvement despite increased share-based compensation expenses.

kpis.name: Income from Operations
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core business operations before interest, taxes and other non-operating items.
kpis.description: Income from operations for fiscal year 2025 was $1.28 million, down 13% from $1.47 million in the prior year, due to increased share-based compensation expenses and costs associated with opening the third store.
kpis.signal: Decline due to share-based compensation increases and expansion-related expenses.

kpis.name: Gross Profit
kpis.explanation: Revenue minus direct costs of production and sales, indicating the profitability of core operations before overhead expenses.
kpis.description: Gross profit for fiscal year 2025 was $12.56 million, up $1.41 million (12.6%) from $11.15 million in the prior year, primarily driven by scale economies.
kpis.signal: Gross profit growth sustained by retail portfolio expansion and profitability improvements.

risks.title: Federal-state legal conflict over cannabis
risks.score_rationale: Dominant risk in 10-K (Item 1A, first major section). Highly intense language: "illegal under U.S. federal law", "material negative effect", "could lose entire investment". Trend stable but persistent despite administrative changes. Maximum categorical weight: existential threat to core business.

risks.title: Federal political uncertainty and Cole Memo revocation
risks.score_rationale: Central position in Item 1A with chronological detail: Cole Memo 2013 to Sessions Memo 2018 to Garland 2021. Repeated uncertainty language: "no assurance", "unclear", "could change". Trend up: administrative changes create volatility. Critical categorical weight: federal protection depends on unpredictable political priorities.

risks.title: Operational risks and inadequate insurance
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly enumerated in Item 1A: "operational risks and may not be adequately insured". Moderate but comprehensive language: disputes, accidents, fires, natural disasters, non-compliance. Trend stable. High categorical weight: cultivation and extraction facilities are vulnerable.

risks.title: Money laundering risk and financing restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in Item 1A: "proceeds of crime", "money laundering statutes", "Bank Secrecy Act". Moderate but specific alert language. Trend stable. High categorical weight: access to financing and dividend payments directly affected.

risks.title: Taxation and specialized cannabis industry fees
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 1A as "potential yet unknown risk" with cautious language: "multiple states considering". Trend up: several states under examination. Moderate categorical weight: direct financial impact but predictable compared to federal risks.

risks.title: Reputational risk related to vape products
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Item 1A: September 2019 onwards, CDC findings November 2019. Moderate language: "material source of revenue", "out of abundance of caution". Trend down: situation stabilized after lifting bans (Oregon January 2020). Moderate categorical weight: vape is material revenue source but media risk is managed.

risks.title: Regulatory uncertainty and rapidly evolving legal framework
risks.score_rationale: Cross-cutting theme in Item 1A: "highly regulated, highly competitive and rapidly evolving", "subject to evolving interpretations". Repeated uncertainty language: "cannot predict", "impossible to determine". Trend up: potential new federal regulations (FDA, SEC, DOJ) may become applicable. High categorical weight: compliance costs and operational obsolescence risk.

risks.title: Risk of state cannabis legalization laws being repealed or overturned
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned twice in Item 1A: "no guarantee that state laws will not be repealed or overturned". Moderate cautious language. Trend stable but structural risk. Moderate categorical weight: depends on state political context.
